welcome.title: Welcome, {name}
welcome.body: A network of neighbors sharing what they grow: vegetables, seeds, seedlings and supplies.

map.title: Find gardens near you
map.body: Each pin is a garden. Search for a product or filter by type.

exchange.title: Propose an exchange
exchange.body: Tap a garden, pick what you'd like and write to them. Your email is never shown.

messages.title: Sort it out in messages
messages.body: Replies arrive in Messages. You can also turn on notifications there.

share.title: Share your garden
share.body: Post what you have to spare and your neighbors will find you.
